notes: New guided first dive: June talks you through the controls one at a time, a first survey, a first animal photo and the trip home to the workshop. Hold Backspace to skip it.
June has a new portrait and an animated speech bubble, with a soft talking sound as her words appear.
The briefing is shorter: the control cards moved into the first dive.
Surveys, landmarks, unlocks, chests and new subs now arrive as small notebook slips on the left, each with its own icon. The large centre text is gone.
The song and artist now show under the map name while the radio is on.
Subs float at the right height on the surface.
The whale bones are rebuilt as a proper skeleton and renamed "The leviathan arch".
The up/down speed readout under the depth gauge is removed.
New opening: the R.V. Lost Cause, a briefing from June and the sub launch, in daylight. Enter or A moves on, Esc skips.
Finish everything in the Lantern Archipelago, then board the ship to sail to Frostglass Shelf. The old portal is gone.
Clean title cards for discoveries, landmarks and unlocks.
Distant land on the horizon is now clean layered silhouettes.
Stations are named: Lantern station is home, the others are "<name> station".
Sub models detailed: Longfin, Needle, Bell, Twinfin. Terrapin rebuilt as a domed sub. Hermit slimmed down. Fishbowl hatch fixed.
New cabin interiors on eight subs: proper pilot seats, control yokes, displays, gauges and pedals.
Bow arms, the bumper and the halo lights no longer run through each other; the bumper opens into two rails when an arm is fitted.
